# ThemeSwitch

<!-- Generated by js/scripts/widget-pages.mjs from the trait contract: edit the schema
     or the script, then run it again. -->

Three-position switch for the theme: light, system, dark (STYLE-007, STYLE-008).

![ThemeSwitch, light theme](../img/widgets/theme-switch-light.png#only-light){ width="250" }
![ThemeSwitch, dark theme](../img/widgets/theme-switch-dark.png#only-dark){ width="250" }

**Layout and session** · [Widget catalog](../widgets.md) · [API reference](../api.md#anywidget_instruments.ThemeSwitch) ·
schema [`themeswitch.schema.json`](../trait-contract.md)

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.ThemeSwitch(value="system", label="Theme", page_theme=False)
```

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page_theme` | boolean | `true` | host | Also switch the notebook page theme where the host allows it (marimo). |
| `size` | array | `[240,30]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `value` | `"auto"`, `"light"`, `"system"`, `"dark"` | `"auto"` | host, widget | Selected theme; auto until a position is chosen. With a Python kernel, every widget of the kernel follows it; other hosts apply the page theme only (STYLE-008). |
